caption: Windmills, Schiedam
composition: Tall brick stage mills along the urban canal · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Along the canal in Schiedam, tall brick tower mills stand among warehouses, each with a wooden gallery, a dark cap, and lattice sails. This is a city water, not a polder row and not a green wooden mill. The sky is overcast, about 17.7°C, with wind near 10.4 km/h. Canal lamps light the brick. No mill name is readable.
